name: Eco-Connect Community Fund
summary: Small grants of up to AUD 2,000 per group per year for community-led environmental work in the Northern Territory, including native planting and restoration, weed control and caring for local natural areas.

amount.note: Per group per year; groups may submit several applications up to the annual cap.

status.quote: Applications are open year-round Applications are assessed monthly

applicant_types.quote: Community or volunteer groups Indigenous groups and organisations Ranger groups Not-for-profit organisations Schools

geography.quote: support small-scale, community-led environmental projects, activities and capacity-building initiatives across the Northern Territory

access.quote: Submit your application online at any time while funding is available.

window.quote: Applications are open year-round Applications are assessed monthly

amount.quote: Funding available: Up to $2,000 per group, per year
